text: What if you could teach a computer anything, just by showing it once?
Every day, people film themselves doing things. Cooking. Fixing. Building. Billions of hours of it.
Meet Eye-doss. Show it one video, and it learns the skill.
It watches. Then it writes down every step, in order, like a recipe it can check.
Then it watches you. Through any camera. It knows which step you're on, and what comes next.
Miss a step, and it tells you. Right then. Not after.
And it's not just for people. Show a robot arm once. Knock its work over, and it notices, and fixes it.
Built on Meta's A.I. models, for the Meta Global A.I. Hackathon.
Made by Maruthi Kunchala, Team Pulse Parallax. This is Eye-doss. Show it once.
